technical_facts: Implemented fixed pitch clamping
Added Com_PageInMemory functionality
Fixed menu cursor timing
Resolved a bug where net connect occurred during gameplay
Implemented custom skins
Fixed a bug where server updates could occur without game updates
Updated version numbers
Modified console behavior to prevent entering half console until connected
Added a delay before firing the BFG
Modified stairup logic to allow wall climbing
Resolved issues with previous frames
Optimized frame.packetentities by avoiding copying all entities
Disabled server pause in deathmatch (dm) mode
Normalized skin texture coordinates for software rendering
Added splashing sounds for swimming in water
Implemented IPX support
Implemented software rendering for underwater surfaces
Added a 'nopredict' option at the server level
Implemented inventory scrolling
Implemented smooth step-up logic
Removed rand1k
Configured func_explosive targets to fire when starting in deathmatch
personality_patterns: Preference for concise, bulleted progress tracking
Focus on iterative bug fixing and feature refinement
High volume of small, discrete task completion

gnosis_principles.description: Continuous improvement of game mechanics and stability through a series of small, targeted fixes and additions.
Avoiding unnecessary data copying (e.g., frame.packetentities) to maintain efficiency.
Adding sensory details (splashing sounds) and smoothing movement (smooth step up) to improve the feel of the game.

heritage_patterns: Use of .plan files for public, transparent development logs
Low-level memory management and coordinate normalization for software renderers
Network synchronization and prediction options (nopredict) for multiplayer stability

dpo_pairs.prompt: What change did Carmack make to the BFG weapon in the 1997-11-02 plan file?
dpo_pairs.chosen: He added a delay before firing the BFG.
dpo_pairs.rejected: He increased the damage of the BFG.

dpo_pairs.prompt: How did Carmack handle skin textures for software rendering in this update?
dpo_pairs.chosen: He normalized the skin texture coordinates for software rendering.
dpo_pairs.rejected: He removed skin textures to improve software performance.

dpo_pairs.prompt: What was the fix regarding frame.packetentities?
dpo_pairs.chosen: He decided not to copy all of frame.packetentities to optimize the process.
dpo_pairs.rejected: He deleted the frame.packetentities system entirely.
